title: 京胡的音準
subject: a piano tuner called to an opera troupe's practice room finds the upright piano tuned to A 440 while the jinghu player insists on a lower pitch, so the two argue and finally meet in the middle
caption: Peking-opera-tinged jingju pop, brisk 4/4 with jingju percussion accents and a theatre practice-room setting. jinghu fiddle sawing a bright nasal melody, yueqin moon-lute plucked in quick rhythmic patterns, bangu small drum and clappers marking sharp accents, upright piano with a bright hammered tone playing the chords, a bass guitar on the roots. dry close tight acoustic mix with theatre-stage room ambience, bright and forward, no wash of reverb. male lead with a clear forward jingju-flavoured tone, crisp consonants and short ornamented phrases, clearly sung not shouted. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 120 BPM, E major. brisk, comic, warm mood. No rap, no autotune, no synth bass, no electronic drums, no electric guitar, no sustained opera falsetto screeching.
lyrics:
[Intro - jinghu, bangu and piano]

[Verse 1]
劇團練功房 一台老鋼琴
我帶著音叉 來調音
我說 標準音 四四零
胡琴師傅 皺了眉頭

[Pre-Chorus]
他說 我們的調 低半個音
我說 琴鍵 不能說改就改

[Chorus]
你低一點 我高一點
音叉敲一敲 大家聽一聽
你的弦鬆 我的鍵緊
我們中間見

[Verse 2]
他拉一段 我按一個鍵
他搖頭 我也搖頭
旁邊的花旦 笑到彎腰
她說 你們兩個 才是一齣戲

[Chorus]
你低一點 我高一點
音叉敲一敲 大家聽一聽
你的弦鬆 我的鍵緊
這一次 對上了

[Bridge - bangu and piano alone]
鋼琴不會唱戲
胡琴不會彈和弦
可是一起響 就是一個調

[Chorus]
你低一點 我高一點
音叉敲一敲 大家聽一聽
你的弦鬆 我的鍵緊
我們中間見

[Outro - jinghu and bangu, with a final piano chord]
師傅說 明天 再來調一次
